text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time has come for our final showdown at the Arima Kinen. Despite her temporary hiatus, Agnes Tachyon is back in action and officially in the running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired by Manhattan Cafe's running and the distant light she saw, Agnes Tachyon returns and sets her sights on the frontier beyond the very limits of Umamusume-kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Agnes Tachyon declaring that the world beyond is hers for the taking, Manhattan Cafe comes to see a striking resemblance between her and her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having both guided and run alongside each other, the two racers head for the gates—each with their own destinations in mind.
